target_policy.credentials: Public demo credentials supplied through DUMMYJSON_USERNAME and DUMMYJSON_PASSWORD
target_policy.stability: External service availability and findings may change independently of this repository

evals.prompt: 使用公开练习 API 验证登录前置步骤：未登录访问受保护接口应失败，登录获取 Bearer token 后应能读取当前用户，再执行只读 schema smoke。
evals.expected_output: Verify the 401 precondition, log in without printing credentials or tokens, verify the authenticated user, run Schemathesis against GET /auth/me, and persist a redacted normalized result.

assertions.text: The unauthenticated request returns 401 and the authenticated request returns the login user
A Schemathesis result with status passed or failed is accepted; execution/configuration errors are rejected
The access token and password are absent from the normalized result
